paite: Huan Bazaleel in singgi sing in bawm abawl a, adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi a, availam tong khat-le-akim, huan asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Bawlna / (Eks 25.10-22)

paite: Dangka-engtak in asunglam leh apolam aluan a, dangka-eng lallukhu akimvel in abawl hi.
Aning lite a bulh ding in dangka-eng sikkual li asung hi. Apang khat asikkual nih, apang khat lam ah sikkual nih.
Singgi sing in zawl abawl a, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Huan bawm pang a sikkual sung ah, bawm zawnna ding in hiai zawlte athunlut hi.
Dangka-engtak in zahngaihna tutphah abawl a; tong nih-le-akim adunglam ahi a, tong khat-le-akim availam ahi.
Dangka-eng sekkhiak in zahngaihna tutphah mong nihte tuak ah cherubte abawl hi.
Hiai lam pang mong ah cherub khat, huai lam pang mong ah cherub dang khat, zahngaihna tutphah a pan among langnihte ah cherubte abawl hi.
Cherubte'n tunglam ah akha uh azak ua, zahngaihna tutphah tunglam ah, amai uh kingattuah in, akha un akhuh ua; zahngaihna tutphah lam ah cherubte mai a-om hi.
Singgi sing in dohkan abawl a; adunglam tong nih ahi a, availam tong khat, huan asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
heading: Tanghou Koihna Dohkan Bawlna / (Eks 25.23-30)

paite: Dangka-engtak in aluan a, akimvel in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
Huai lou in huai ah akimvel in khutpek chia in agei abawl a; akimvel in agei ding in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
Dangka-eng sikkual li asung a, akhe lite a om aning lite tung ah sikkualte abulh hi.
Ageichin ah, dohkan puakna ding chiangte a ding in mun, sikkualte a-om uhi.
Singgi sing in chiangte abawl a, dohkan puakna ding in, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Dohkan tung a om tui-um belsuan abawl a, akuangte leh asikkeute leh anoubemte leh akhuhna ding singte, dangka-engtak in abawl hi.
Khawnvak koihna dangka-engtak in abawl a; sekthoh in khawnvak koihna abawl hi. Akungpi, ahiang, anoubemte leh amumte leh apakte kibang chiat uhi.
heading: Khawnvak Koihna Bawlna / (Eks 25.31-40)

paite: Apangte a pan hiang guk akakhia a; khawnvak koihna hiang thum apang khat a pan, apang dang a pan khawnvak koihna hiang thum.
Noubem thum makha gah bang a bawl hiang khat ah, amum leh apak; noubem thum makha gah bang a bawl hiang dang ah, amum leh apak, huchibang in hiang guk teng ah khawnvak koihna a pan in.
Khawnvak koihna makha gah bang a bawl noubem li a-om; amumte leh apakte toh.
Akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, hiang gukte bang zel in akakhia uhi.
Amumte uh leh ahiangte uh kibang ahi ua: avek un dangka-engtak sekthoh ahi.
Khawnvak sagihte, meihalnate leh meivu kuangte dangka-engtak in abawl hi.
Dangka-engtak talent khat in tui-um belsuan teng abawl hi.
Gimlim maitam singgi sing in abawl a; adunglam tong khat ahi, availam tong khat; kiptak a bawl ahi a; asanlam tong nih ahi. Akibang vek uhi.
heading: Gimnamtui Halna Maitam Bawlna / (Eks 30.1-5)

paite: Dangka-engtak in atung leh akimvel in apangte leh akite aluan hi. Huai lou leng akimvel in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
Alallukhu nuai ah dangka-eng in sikkual nih abawl a, aning nihte kiang ah, asik nihte tung ah, apuakna ding chiangte omna ding in.
Huan singgi sing in zawlte abawl a, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Nilh theih thau siangthou, gim-namtui siangthou, gimlim bawlmi hih bang in abawl hi.
heading: Nilh Theih Sathau Leh Gimnamtui Bawlna / (Eks 30.22-38)
